modern: All things are the same: familiar in experience, short-lived in time, and worthless in their matter. Everything now is just as it was in the time of those whom we have buried.

explained.summary: Everything is the same old story: familiar from experience, over quickly, and made of nothing precious. Life now is just as it was for the people we’ve already buried. Marcus is deflating the sense that the present is uniquely important.
